notes.title: Version 2
notes.notes:
Hello Job-Seekers,



Wow! It's been 3 whole years since we released the original Mangotronics Employment Collection, can you believe it?

I'm so proud of all the things we've accomplished and now, I'm thrilled to be able to announce a huge update- Version 2!

With Version 2 comes new features, new games by new indie developers, and a completely overhauled launcher UI built from a new engine in a "Fake OS" style so you can organize your in-launcher game collection however you want.

Here's what to expect in the update:

10 new games 

10 new devs

100% FREE!

New launcher featuring Mango OS

Steam Deck support

A secret 11th game?



Version 2 is a free content update for everyone who already owns The Mangotronics Employment Collection, bringing the total up to 19 games and demos.

The release date will be announced as soon as we have a complete, tested and working build.

Thank you for your continued support throughout the last 3 years, and here's to an amazing 3 more!



Welcome to the Team!

-Matt from Mangotronics
